title: Godzilla: Rettou Shinkan
overview:
Real Time Monster Attack Simulation

Vicious monsters are landing one after another! G-Force, sortie!

- Real-time play with the battle screen and movement screen combined into one!
- The screen uses a diagonal top-down quarter view!
- Many live-action movies of the monsters and super weapons that appear!

凶悪怪獣続々上陸!
Gフォース出撃せよ!

・戦闘画面と移動画面がひとつになったリアルタイムプレイ!
・画面は斜め見おろし型のクォータービューを採用!
・登場怪獣や超兵器の実写ムービー多数!
